products.name: Smart Color-Changing Foundation Stick
products.description: Revolutionary color-changing foundation that adapts perfectly to your unique skin tone using micro-encapsulated pigment technology. Provides buildable coverage with a natural, second-skin finish.

products.name: Portable UV-C Sterilizer Wand
products.description: Handheld UV-C sterilizer wand that kills 99.9% of germs and bacteria on any surface. Cordless, lightweight, and perfect for sanitizing groceries, phones, countertops, and travel items.

products.name: Ergonomic Memory Foam Lumbar Pillow
products.description: Premium memory foam lumbar support pillow for office chairs and car seats. Relieves back pain, improves posture, and features breathable mesh cover with adjustable straps.

products.name: LED Grow Light Strips for Plants
products.description: Full-spectrum LED grow light strips with auto timer and 3 brightness modes. Perfect for indoor plants, succulents, and seed starting. USB powered with adhesive backing for easy installation.

products.name: Magnetic Wireless Car Charger Mount
products.description: Strong magnetic wireless car charger mount compatible with all MagSafe phones. 15W fast charging, 360-degree adjustable arm, and one-touch release for easy phone access while driving.

products.name: Organic Bamboo Kitchen Towels (6-Pack)
products.description: Reusable organic bamboo kitchen towels that are 5x more absorbent than cotton. Each towel lasts 6+ months, replaces 60+ paper towel rolls, and is naturally antibacterial.

products.name: Heated Shiatsu Neck Massager
products.description: Deep-kneading Shiatsu neck massager with infrared heat therapy. Features 8 massage nodes, 3 speed levels, and adjustable compression. Perfect for tension relief after long work days.

products.name: Smart Water Bottle with Temperature Display
products.description: Insulated smart water bottle with LED temperature display, time-to-drink reminders, and motivational glow rings. Keeps drinks cold 24hrs or hot 12hrs. BPA-free with leak-proof lid.

products.name: Premium Microfiber Car Detailing Kit (16-Piece)
products.description: Complete car detailing kit with 16 premium microfiber towels. Includes waffle weave drying towel, glass cleaning cloths, wax applicators, and buffing pads. Lint-free, scratch-safe, and machine washable for 500+ washes.

products.name: Cordless Electric Pressure Washer
products.description: Portable cordless electric pressure washer with 600 PSI max power. Dual lithium batteries provide 45 minutes of runtime. Includes foam cannon, turbo nozzle, and carrying case. Perfect for cars, patios, and outdoor furniture.

products.name: Ceramic Car Wax Spray - Hydrophobic Coating
products.description: Professional-grade ceramic spray wax with SiO2 polymer technology. Provides 12 months of hydrophobic protection, UV resistance, and deep gloss. Easy spray-on, wipe-off application. One bottle covers 2-3 full-size vehicles.

products.name: Electric Spin Scrubber with 6 Interchangeable Heads
products.description: Cordless electric spin scrubber with 450 RPM motor and 6 interchangeable brush heads for tiles, grout, glass, and floors. Extendable handle reaches high walls and tight corners. Rechargeable battery runs 90 minutes per charge.

products.name: Automatic Robot Window Cleaner
products.description: Smart robotic window cleaner with AI path planning and edge detection. Dual suction pads hold securely on glass, tile, and smooth surfaces. Cleans both sides of windows in a single pass. App-controlled with scheduled cleaning mode.

products.name: Portable Carpet & Upholstery Spot Cleaner
products.description: Portable spot cleaner with 800W suction power for carpets, rugs, sofas, and car interiors. Removes pet stains, wine spills, and dirt with water and cleaning solution. Lightweight 8lb design with 10ft hose reach.

products.name: Steam Mop with Reusable Microfiber Pads
products.description: High-temperature steam mop that sanitizes floors without chemicals. Heats up in 15 seconds, kills 99.9% of bacteria, and comes with 3 reusable microfiber pads. Swivel head reaches under furniture. 12oz water tank provides 20 minutes of steam.

products.name: Multi-Purpose Natural Cleaning Paste
products.description: All-natural coconut oil cleaning paste that works on every surface. Removes grease, stickers, soap scum, and marks from stainless steel, glass, wood, tile, and plastic. Plant-based ingredients, biodegradable, and smells like fresh lemons.

products.name: Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner with 45min Runtime
products.description: Lightweight cordless stick vacuum with 25KPa cyclonic suction. Converts to handheld for cars and furniture. HEPA filtration captures 99.97% of allergens. LED headlight illuminates hidden dust. Wall-mountable charging dock included.

products.name: Silicone Fast Drying Dish Mat with Drain Tray
products.description: Extra-large silicone dish drying mat with built-in drain tray and raised ridges for airflow. Holds up to 30 dishes. Folds flat for storage. Heat resistant to 500F, BPA-free, and dishwasher safe. Non-slip grip keeps mat in place.

products.name: Portable Upholstery & Fabric Cleaner Machine
products.description: Handheld upholstery cleaner with 600W motor for deep cleaning sofas, car seats, mattresses, and curtains. Dual tank system separates clean and dirty water. Includes crevice tool and stain brush. Removes pet odors and deep-set stains.

products.name: Handheld Garment & Fabric Steamer
products.description: Portable handheld steamer with 1000W fast heating and continuous steam for 15 minutes. Works on clothes, curtains, upholstery, and bedding. Removes wrinkles, odors, and kills 99% of dust mites. Compact design for travel.

products.name: Car Seat Gap Filler & Organizer (2-Pack)
products.description: Silicone car seat gap fillers that bridge the space between car seat and center console. Prevents phones, keys, snacks, and cards from falling into the abyss. Universal fit for all vehicles. Easy install with no tools required.

products.name: Handheld Portable Car Vacuum Cleaner 8000Pa
products.description: Powerful handheld car vacuum with 8000Pa cyclone suction, HEPA filter, and dual LED lights. Rechargeable lithium battery provides 30 minutes of runtime. Includes crevice tool, brush nozzle, and blow function. Wet/dry capable.

products.name: Car Interior LED Ambient Strip Lights - App Controlled
products.description: RGB LED strip lights for car interior with smartphone app control. 16 million colors, music sync mode, and 6 dynamic scenes. Easy plug-and-play installation via USB or 12V port. Self-adhesive backing for dashboard, footwells, and doors.

products.name: Car Scratch & Swirl Remover Pen Kit
products.description: DIY car scratch repair pen with clear coat formula. Fills scratches, swirl marks, and chips on any car paint color. Includes polishing cloth and sanding pad. Water-resistant and UV-protective finish. Works in 3 easy steps.

products.name: Long-Lasting Car Air Freshener Vent Clip (6-Pack)
products.description: Premium car vent air freshener clips with natural essential oils. Each clip lasts 45+ days. Variety pack includes Fresh Linen, Ocean Breeze, Black Ice, Vanilla, Citrus, and Lavender. Adjustable intensity dial. Fits all standard AC vents.

products.name: Universal Car Phone Holder - Dashboard Mount
products.description: Universal car phone mount with powerful suction cup and 360-degree rotating arm. Fits all phones up to 6.9 inches including iPhone 16 Pro Max and Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra. One-touch clamping with silicone padding. Heat-resistant for all climates.

products.name: Collapsible Car Trunk Organizer with Cooler Compartment
products.description: Heavy-duty collapsible trunk organizer with insulated cooler compartment for groceries and drinks. 200lb capacity, waterproof interior lining, and adjustable dividers. Non-slip bottom keeps it in place. Folds flat when not in use. Reflective strips for safety.

products.name: Waterproof Car Seat Cover Set - Heavy Duty (2-Pack)
products.description: Universal-fit waterproof car seat covers with 5-layer protection. Blocks spills, pet hair, mud, and UV rays. Front bucket seat pair with separate headrest covers. Easy 5-minute installation with elastic straps and anchor clips. Machine washable.

copy_templates.hero_headline: Finally, a Foundation That Actually Matches Your Skin
copy_templates.hero_subheadline: The color-changing formula adapts to YOUR unique skin tone in seconds — no guessing, no mismatches, no returns
copy_templates.pain_hook: Tired of foundations that are too light, too dark, or just... wrong?
mechanisms: Smart color-adapting microcapsules that activate on contact with your skin's pH
Skin-identical pigment technology that blends into any undertone
24-hour wear without touchups, transfers, or oxidation
bullet_features: Matches any skin tone automatically — no shade-matching required
Feels weightless like second skin with buildable medium-to-full coverage
Infused with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E for skincare benefits
Cruelty-free, vegan, and formulated without parabens or sulfates
One shade fits 98% of skin tones — clinically tested on 2000+ women
copy_templates.testimonial_1: I've finally found a foundation that works for my olive skin tone. The color change is like magic! — Sarah K.
copy_templates.testimonial_2: At 54, foundation has been tricky for me. This stayed put 24 hours with zero retouch. Incredible! — Maria G.
copy_templates.testimonial_3: The color-change is mind-blowing. It blends perfectly every single time. I'm never going back. — Jessica T.
